propositions: Documentation inconsistency: _lib_writes.py claims force waives unresolved-children restriction, but transition.py and transition_close.py enforce it unconditionally regardless of force.
The unresolved-children close restriction is a ticket-system invariant, not a gate, and therefore should never be bypassable by force.
Force semantics must be documented as bypassing all gates (current and future) rather than enumerating specific gates.
Public API contract across Python library, CLI, MCP, user guide, and agent guidance must consistently define force as gate-bypass-only and explicitly exclude ticket invariants.
Contract tests must verify that force bypasses enabled gates but cannot close a parent ticket while any child remains non-closed.
